name: Triceratops
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the already indexed original portrait. The anatomy matches the general dinosaur named by the source.
habitatEvidence: Editorial habitat suggestions for the large herbivorous dinosaur. The print descriptions supply behavior but no habitat list.
mechanicsNotes: Trampling Charge uses the printed DC 13 in both books. The charge does not list a separate damage rider.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the already indexed original portrait. The anatomy matches the general dinosaur named by the source.
habitatEvidence: Editorial habitat suggestions for an enormous terrestrial predator. The printed text describes territorial hunting with no named habitat.
mechanicsNotes: The printed Bite auto-grapples a Medium or smaller creature and restrains it until the grapple ends. Multiattack requires two different targets.
The Basic Rules lore at the top of p. 157’s second column describes the tyrannosaurus. The Warhorse Charge below it is unrelated. Neither dinosaur block in scope lists a Swallow action.
